paragraphs: (In Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim: bar Bizna.) He was Rava’s student, as in [Bava Batra 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.16b.15-16): Ravina and Rav Chama bar Buzi were sitting before Rava, and Rava was dozing. Ravina said to him: “Is it true that you say (in Rabbi Yochanan’s name), ‘Every death…’?” etc. He said, “Yes.” Meanwhile Rava woke up and said to them: “Children, thus said Rabbi Yochanan,” etc. In [Berakhot 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.50a.13) Ravina and Rav Chama bar Buzi came to the Exilarch’s house; Rav Chama rose and was looking for [a group of] a hundred. Ravina said to him: “You need not. This is what Rava said,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: In Bava Batra, Ravina questions Rav Chama, and Rava wakes and states what Rabbi Yochanan said. In Berakhot, Ravina speaks in the name of Rava about the size of the group. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1349&lang=en) also records the Ein Yaakov form bar Bizna.
